description: This file contains the implementation of the inflate module of zlib, including functions for initializing, resetting, and decompressing data streams, as well as internal state management and error handling.

methods.name: inflateReset
methods.description: Resets the inflate stream to start decompression anew.

methods.name: inflateEnd
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the inflate stream.

methods.name: inflateInit2_
methods.description: Initializes the inflate stream with specified window size and version.

methods.name: inflate
methods.description: Performs decompression of the input data stream.
